---
title: "Practice"
---

Alongside my research, I create and facilitate places where people come together and talk. These activities are also listed on the [CV](/en/cv.qmd) page. Most of the linked pages are in Japanese.

## Café Talks {#cafe-talks}

- UTalk ([website](https://fukutake.iii.u-tokyo.ac.jp/utalk/))\
  A monthly science café hosted by Fukutake Hall, the University of Tokyo, where general participants talk casually with a researcher of UTokyo. I have been involved since 2019 and now serve as a host ([sessions I hosted](#utalk-host)).

- Acchi Kocchi Talk ([Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/acchi.kocchi.talk/))\
  A talk event at a local café, started in April 2026 and run with a friend. I plan the events and facilitate them.
